corrections.corrected_statement: To qualify for a license you must have binocular vision and visual acuity of at least twenty over forty in each eye and a continuous field of vision of at least one hundred forty degrees.
corrections.note: Removed the definition of both eyes working together because the page only lists the term without defining it.

corrections.corrected_statement: Driving below the posted limit for bad conditions is legal, but exceeding the posted limit is illegal even if traffic around you is faster.
In a hydroplane you do not brake, while in a skid you may brake once the tires grip again.
corrections.note: The skid brake-after-traction rule is on page 29, not page 30.

corrections.corrected_statement: A provisional license holder may drive unsupervised between twelve midnight and five in the morning only when driving to from or during a job or to or from an organized volunteer program an official school activity or an athletic event or related training session.
corrections.note: Added the three missing nighttime exceptions beyond work.

corrections.corrected_statement: A steady red requires you to stay stopped for as long as it is red, whereas after stopping at a flashing red you may go once the way is clear.
corrections.note: The flashing-red proceed-when-clear rule is on page 18, not page 17.
